name: archive_review
description: Night Council integration — reviews, consolidates, and archives old notes and memory entries

age_threshold_days.description: Notes older than this get reviewed for archival

params.query: notes and entries older than {{age_threshold_days}} days that may need consolidation or archival

params.prompt:
You are Hermes running the Night Council archive review. Based on the following memory entries, identify:
1. Entries that can be consolidated (similar topics that should be merged)
2. Entries that are stale and can be archived
3. Entries that contain important long-term knowledge to preserve
4. Any orphaned entries with no clear connection to other memory

Memory entries:
{{step_0}}

params.content: Night Council review completed. Consolidation and archival recommendations generated from step_1.
